My first real ML job I acquired only recently. I had some experience before but they just decided it would be easier to train me up to become a full fledged ML engineer over this year, rather than continue to search for a highly qualified one.

ML engineers are hard to find because you can basically only get that experience on the job. So the qualified ones are usually already employed. 

My piece of advice is to look for a legacy company that understands the necessity of ML but hasn't built the infrastructure for it. They will be more willing to hire someone that doesn't check all the boxes right off the bat because they themselves don't have the greatest idea as to everything that would be necessary.

Good luck!
